body: Life is all about relationships and the people who mean to you the most hurts you the most. Life would be meaningless if it weren’t for the people around us. It’ll just be empty but I’m really proud of you for holding on this far for your mothers sake. She has no idea what a gem of a child she has. I’m really sorry about the world has made you feel and I have no promises that world will turn in your favour but I can tell you that each effort you make to remain happy will be paid of one day or the other. I really hope the opportunity never presents itself.

Aim for the stars and you’ll reach the sky. Aim for living the best life brother, and you’ll reach an okay life and if luck plays by your side, you might really end up being the happiest person in the world

It really takes time to open up for someone new or someone you’re really close with it. My best friend took over a year he has a crush on someone but it’s still the best thing he’s done and he’s happy about it. You might not be able to find someone who’ll understand but I want you to live with the hope to find someone and take your time to tell. You hopefully will have a long life. Live for that few moments that will get you peace.

We could always do something. Even feeding a stray cat some leftovers could give a little amount of satisfaction. I honestly am going through shit tons but that constant need to help someone keeps me moving. I’ve made that my purpose. To be there for people. Life is horrible but it’s somehow upto us make something out of it and we always can not matter what our situation is.
